text: The evidence does not show forest loss across the **surrounding region**—it confirms no detectable loss **within** the asset boundary (2843 ha) from 2021 to 2025. All observed losses occurred **before the 2020 baseline** (e.g., 67.7 ha in 2020, 25.5 ha in 2015). Post-2020, only a **0.4-ha patch** (below the 0.5-ha threshold) was flagged, which is not counted as an event. The data sources (Hansen GFC, JRC GFC2020) cover the full asset area but only confirm **no significant loss during the claim period**. No broader regional trends are assessed.
